storage.git: registry/archives/*.json stores published source text, metadata, original links, and separately versioned translations/editorials. Daily refresh preserves reviewed editions byte-for-byte; registry/archive-observations/*.json retains newer captures separately, with review_required when their source body differs.
storage.local_only: HTML and working SQLite caches are not committed; local survival depends on this environment. The prior 1359-file local snapshot audit was historical, not a durable backup guarantee.
storage.scope: Source case pages only; linked external article text is not imported.
